lines: A lens marked DAWN.
A lens marked NOON.
A lens marked DUSK.

hint_1: Scratched on the kiln wall: The crew works backwards. Start at the end of the day.

lines: A lens marked NORTH.
A lens marked EAST.
A lens marked SOUTH.
A lens marked WEST.

hint_2: A crew note: Never the way the caravan wants. East, west, north, south. Then laugh.

lines: A caravan bell in a crate marked GLASS. It is not glass. Nothing in this crate is glass.
You take the bell. It keeps quiet, for now.
A caravan bell melted halfway into a glass bottle. Art, says the label. Evidence, says your gut.
You take the bell. It keeps quiet, for now.
A caravan bell hung over a furnace door. It rings when the door opens. Crew alarm, very homely.
You take the bell. It keeps quiet, for now.
A caravan bell on Venn's desk, used as a paperweight on a stack of maps. Every map is wrong.
You take the bell. It keeps quiet, for now.

bell_empty: Nothing left here but a ring in the dust.

lines: A child's scarf on a nail, tied with a terrible knot. Stitched in the corner: a sand-glass, the crew's mark.
You take it to show Tamsin.

scarf_plain: A row of nails with crew coats on them. One coat is child-sized.

lines: A ledger in neat handwriting: 'Bell Line, new posts. Caravans led in: 14. Paid by V.: half. H.'
H. for Hesper. V. takes half. Someone should tell Hesper you know.
A ledger of caravans 'found' on the flats. At the bottom: 'V. takes half.' Underlined twice.

sign: MIRAGE KILN - STAFF ONLY. Staff: everyone who doesn't leave.
aske: Aske: I cut glass into gems. Sell them as gems. Buyers cut themselves on the truth.
aske_intro: Aske: A visitor. Sharp. Let's see if you shatter.
aske_defeat: Aske: Chipped. Don't tell the buyers.
bree: Bree: I watch the door. Nobody's come in who wasn't supposed to. You're the first. Congratulations.
bree_intro: Bree: Lookouts don't lose. We just see it coming.
bree_defeat: Bree: Saw that coming. Didn't help.
hob: Hob: Hot work. Pays in glass beads. Glass beads don't buy water. I've checked.
hob_intro: Hob: You're letting the heat out. That's a fight.
hob_defeat: Hob: Cooled off. First time in years.
lark: Lark: I sell what caravans lose. Caravans lose a lot round here. Funny, that.
lark_intro: Lark: Everything's for sale. Your Spirlings first.
odo: Odo: I blow the bottles for the fake oasis water. Same water, fancier bottle, triple price.
odo_intro: Odo: Hold your breath. I always do.
odo_defeat: Odo: Out of breath. Occupational hazard.
rusk: Rusk: Lovely field guide, this. Every den, every rock. The naturalist sold it to me herself. Very proud of her work.
rusk_intro: Rusk: You're in the book too. Under 'nuisance'.
rusk_defeat: Rusk: Take the guide. I've memorised the good pages anyway. Joking. Mostly.
garr: Garr: I stand by the door and look big. Some days I also am big.
garr_intro: Garr: Boss is busy. Being chained up. Don't ask.
garr_defeat: Garr: Smaller than I looked. Noted.
